description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'Item' class in the 'Opencart' admin extension for shipping. It handles the display and saving of shipping item configuration in the OpenCart backend, including loading language resources, setting breadcrumbs, loading models, and rendering views.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Controller class for managing the shipping item extension configuration in OpenCart's admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the shipping item configuration form, including loading necessary language resources, models, and setting up data for the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of shipping item configuration settings, including permission checks, updating settings in the database, and returning a JSON response.
